title: Near-Optimal Learning of Local Lindbladians
summary: We study the problem of learning local Lindbladians from black-box access to the physical evolution, where the goal is to estimate all Hamiltonian and dissipative coefficients. For local Lindbladians with low-intersection dissipators and local dynamical strength at most $Λ$, we design an algorithm that learns the coefficients to target accuracy $\varepsilon$, whose number of channel uses and total evolution time scale as $\widetilde{O}(Λ^2/\varepsilon^2)$ and $\widetilde{O}(Λ/\varepsilon^2)$, respectively, with only logarithmic dependence on the number of qubits.
